configuration.appearance: Tall cylindrical navigation post, centered configured tiller, bare rounded fork tips, right-hand charging contact panel. Optional mechanical fork bumpers (+41 mm), operator platform and short-post RS camera brackets are omitted. Photos show multiple SAE160 options; none is asserted to be the exact dimensional configuration.
configuration.scanner_assumption: Data-sheet h20=2381/2969 and h21=2362/2950 occupy merged cells across both mast columns. The inherited low-post-to-DX / high-post-to-TX assignment is an explicit configured assumption, not a published per-mast mapping.

compatibility.preserved: All links, frames, joints, axes, limits, velocities, mimic multiplier 0.5, TX free lift, wheel stations, absent inertias.
compatibility.collision_revision: 2026-10-10: boxes added for the centred tiller/head and console top, the HMI crossbar and its two stays (pitched boxes), beacon, foot pins and top shrouds; the carriage plate, ties, stiles and shanks are one box from the plate back to the fork face. Mast-internal guide rollers, the stages' lower crossmembers and the front 7.5 mm of each shroud stay outside so no pair overlaps in only part of the lift.

published_vs_estimated.published: See README fact table: overall dimensions; wheel sizes/tracks/wheelbase; fork length/width/nominal heel thickness; h13; h1/h2/h3/h4/h23; charging center; h14 range. Values are nominal.
published_vs_estimated.independent_visual_estimates: Lofted drive cover, dark battery bay, side guards, console, centered tiller/loop handles, transverse HMI, five contact strips, two rear corner scanner pods, C-channel wall thicknesses, guide rollers, shanks, lower carriage opening, fork/load-wheel slots and toe ramp, wheel finishes, colors and shading. None are measured OEM geometry.
published_vs_estimated.inherited_approximations: Battery/body height 1.10 m; collision silhouette; castor X=drive axle despite source suggesting an aft station; mast channel locations; charging side; 0.5 lift-stage ratio and idealized independent joints. Joints and frames unchanged for API compatibility; collision revised on 2026-10-10 (compatibility.collision_revision).
published_vs_estimated.h4: h4-h23 constrains the inherited above-fork carriage/shank envelope; it does not document a lattice load backrest. The prior invented lattice has been removed visually.
published_vs_estimated.h14: 1150–1385 mm is the driving-position tiller range. The chosen visual pose is an estimate, not a guaranteed stowed/upstanding configuration.
published_vs_estimated.nominal_rounding: TX fork length 1250 + l2 1078 = 2328 mm versus printed l1 2327 mm; endpoint values are not changed to hide rounding. Computed full fork surfaces are 4700.5/2350.5 mm versus printed 4700/2350 mm.
published_vs_estimated.turning: Inherited collision rectangle corner gives 1780 mm vs published 1767 mm, approximately +0.7%; not a validated steering swept volume.
published_vs_estimated.hollow_forks: Independently estimated 12 mm upper deck, 11 mm U-shaped sidewalls, 22 mm toe depth and 240 mm ramp; the 70 mm nominal outer heel section and 1250 x 180 mm plan remain unchanged. Fixed-arm visuals are 128 mm wide and 53 mm high, retaining published 262 mm inner spacing; original 154 x 68 mm contact proxies remain unchanged.
published_vs_estimated.lower_crossmembers: The moving rail pairs are joined by independently positioned lower crossmembers and inward attachment ears. Their placement is chosen to keep the inherited scanner/lift frames and parent-stage sweeps clear; it is not represented as the manufacturer's actual top/bottom weldment layout.

kinematic_representation: No decorative chain, hydraulic piston or hose is fixed across relatively moving links. Unsupported inter-stage rollers are omitted. Carriage rollers are supported by axle brackets entering open channel throats, stiles, a lower plate and an upper tie; they remain independent estimates. Tests cover vertical rail overlap, structural joins, hollow fork/arm clearance and 303 sampled complete scanner/crossmember sweep configurations. No contact solver, OEM load path or swept-volume safety certification is implied.
exclusions: No restricted manual, vendor CAD, third-party mesh, logo, copied diagram, photo texture, or manufacturer artwork is included. No SAE200/SWE160/SAI geometry is substituted. Transparent mast guard omitted because this OBJ/MTL pipeline exports opaque materials.
performance_warning: 1600 kg nameplate does not apply at every lift height. Official auto-mode TX chart at 650 mm load centre gives 690 kg at 4700 mm. Recipe/performance metadata is unchanged in this visual-only task; this model is not a safety/load certificate.
verification: 20 Node tests: byte-identical TX/DX URDF, 72 combined lift/steer/spin poses, 303 scanner/crossmember sweep samples, hollow fork/arm clearances, carriage structural joins, openings and visible wheels, positive closed meshes, deterministic lossless OBJ/MTL. Independent standard-library OBJ topology audit and 27 shared authoring tests pass. Matched Blender static renders supplied; browser UI not run in this environment.
distribution: Independent authored source/generated meshes CC0-1.0. Catalog revisions sae160/r2 and sae160-dx/r2 (unpublished); existing r1 source pins are not replaced.
